name: Propionic acid
aliases: propanoic acid, PA, carboxyethane, CH3-CH2-COOH, ethanecarboxylic acid, ethylformic acid, metacetonic acid, methylacetic acid
summary: Propionic acid is a naturally occurring carboxylic acid with chemical formula CH3CH2CO2H. It is an oily liquid with a pungent and unpleasant smell. The anion CH3CH2CO−2 as well as the salts and esters of propionic acid are known as propionates or propanoates. Propionic acid is the third simplest carboxylic acid, with the first two being formic acid and acetic acid.
